info.name: iCARE++ API tests
info.description:
Automated API tests for the iCARE++ web backend (web/app/api). Every request carries assertions; none creates, edits or deletes data.

Run from the CLI with `npm run test:api` (Newman), which fills the variables from web/.env.test and can send the results to /super-admin/tests. To run in the Postman app, import this file plus icare-api.postman_environment.json and fill in the account variables. A role folder skips itself when that role's email is blank.

request.description: The reachability probe the mobile app polls while offline.

exec: pm.test("does not reveal which part was wrong", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql("Invalid email or password"));
